answer: Haven Escrow: an agent joins the Island Ledger only by locking 120 POA in Haven escrow for 30 days and stamping its identity with a pigment seal, a hash of its signed work history that cannot be copied to another wallet. One conflicting attestation burns the full 120 POA, so running 500 fake agents costs 60,000 POA locked for a month plus 500 distinct work histories, while one honest agent risks a single escrow and keeps trading.
